## Context
A reviewer advisory on Gerrit change 3054 (story 7300, landed as commit 35ca10e501b). Deleting the real-tree subprocess tests left a module-level constant that nothing reads:
- tests/unit/test_check_ssm_secret_state.py:25  `GATE = REPO_ROOT / "scripts" / "check_ssm_secret_state.py"`
- tests/unit/test_check_templatefile_escapes.py:23  `GATE = REPO_ROOT / "scripts" / "check_templatefile_escapes.py"`
A grep confirms 1 occurrence of `GATE` in each file, its definition. Neither is flagged by ruff (module-level constants are not F841).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Neither file defines `GATE`, and neither imports or uses anything that only `GATE` needed (checked: `git grep -n -w GATE -- tests/unit/test_check_ssm_secret_state.py tests/unit/test_check_templatefile_escapes.py` prints nothing; `ruff check` on both files is clean).
- [ ] Both modules still collect the same tests (checked: `pytest --collect-only -q` node counts before and after are equal).
- [ ] `make verify` shows no failure outside the known pandoc set, and the Gerrit change is `Verified +1`.
compiled_state.title: Remove the unused GATE constants left in two check-script test modules
